title: Further proof transformations, modal logic, and ordinal analysis
details: Develop equality-free first-order proof interpolation and general Herbrand extraction beyond leading existential blocks, with quantified contraction handled explicitly. Extend cut transformations and Harrop extraction to calculi preserving logical equality, establish the required equality-enabled conservativity, and retain the exact existential-witness and name-universe hypotheses. Study varying-domain Kripke completeness for constructive first-order logic. For propositional logic, develop terminating G4ip proof search and quantitative bounds on cut elimination. Develop finite-model theorems and decision procedures for KC and LC using constructions that preserve directed or linearly ordered future cones, respectively; canonical completeness and finite-premise compactness alone do not supply those results. Strong normalization and confluence need an explicitly specified local natural-deduction reduction relation and proofs for its arbitrary reduction sequences. For constructive arithmetic, prove preservation of the original native HA axioms under Friedman translation, including finite parameter closure and the allowed free-parameter conditions, and establish an appropriate arithmetic conservativity theorem. Develop realizability, numerical existence and disjunction properties, and provably total functions. Primitive recursive arithmetic and ordinal analysis require their own arithmetic-strength arguments; Goodstein termination by ordinal descent does not establish PA unprovability or a Gentzen consistency theorem. Heyting-algebra semantics needs its lattice foundations. Modal logic belongs in its own area.
